convert_mlcd_checkpoint: convert MLCD model weights from original checkpoint to HuggingFace format
get_mlcd_config: create MLCDVisionConfig for a specified model name with hidden size and layer parameters
get_mlcd_image_processor: create CLIPImageProcessor for MLCD model with normalization and resizing settings
convert_old_keys_to_new_keys: rename state dict keys from original MLCD format to HuggingFace model naming convention
flatten_nested_dict: flatten a nested checkpoint dictionary into a flat key-value dictionary
